agent.finish_summary:
Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py Statement.get_type(): the condition guarding the CTE lookahead loop was inverted (`!= T.Keyword.CTE` instead of `== T.Keyword.CTE`), causing any WITH-prefixed (CTE) statement to skip the loop that finds the trailing DML keyword and fall through to 'UNKNOWN'. Changed the comparison to `==` so the loop runs when the first token is the WITH keyword, correctly walking past the CTE identifier(s)/comments to find and return the real DML keyword (e.g. SELECT).

Reproduction: wrote repro.py asserting sqlparse.parse('WITH a AS (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM a')[0].get_type() == 'SELECT'. With the buggy `!=` condition, this failed with AssertionError: got 'UNKNOWN'. After changing to `==`, the same script passes (OK: SELECT).

Also manually verified: statement with a comment between CTE clauses ('WITH a AS (SELECT 1) -- comment\n, b AS (SELECT 2) SELECT * FROM a') now correctly returns SELECT; plain SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CREATE/DROP statements, empty/whitespace-only statements, and unknown/garbage statements continue to behave as before (unaffected by the fix).
